events.text:
La hipoxia reprograma la expresión génica según el tejido. En corderos, tras el nacimiento se pierde el perfil de grasa parda y disminuye el gasto energético. En cáncer de pulmón, aumenta un regulador que amplifica programas de hipoxia y resistencia terapéutica. En cáncer de cabeza y cuello, marca endotelio angiogénico con metabolismo lipídico alterado. Es orientación preliminar basada en resúmenes.

Síntesis inicial basada en resúmenes recuperados; la verificación detallada sigue en curso.

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de UCP-1 disminuye en grasa perirrenal de cordero en ambos grupos LTH frente a control.
claims.quote: UCP-1 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA lamb perirenal adipose compared to control lambs ( Figure 1(a )).

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de leptina aumenta solo en corderos LTH-SL y no en LTH-HA frente a control.
claims.quote: Leptin mRNA in PRF was significantly higher in LTH-SL lambs but not LTH-HA lamb PRF compared to control lambs ( Figure 1(b )).

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de DIO2 disminuye en ambos grupos LTH frente a control sin diferencias entre ellos.
claims.quote: DIO2 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA compared to control ( Figure 3(a )); no differences were observed between LTH-SL and LTH-HA for DIO2.

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de PGCα disminuye en ambos grupos LTH frente a control.
claims.quote: PGCα was significantly lower in LTH-SL and LTH-HA vs. control ( Figure 3(c )), and no differences were found between either LTH group.

claims.text: Mida la expresión génica como concentración de ARNm en fg por 50 ng de ARN total en grasa perirrenal.

geneticContext.measurement: Messenger RNA concentrations (fg mRNA per 50 ng total RNA)

claims.quote: Messenger RNA concentrations (fg mRNA per 50 ng total RNA) for Uncoupling Protein 1 (UCP1) (a) and leptin (b) in perirenal fat from 14-day old control (CONT) lambs

claims.text: Asocie PPARγ y PGC1α a adipogénesis y DIO2 a producción de T3 para diferenciación grasa parda/beige.
claims.quote: The former two are primary transcriptional switches for adipogenesis, and DIO2 mediates T3 production, which is critical for brown/beige fat differentiation.

claims.text: Assess UCP-1 and PGC1α as significantly decreased in PRF of LTH lambs at ~14 days post-birth.
claims.quote: at ~14 days post-birth both UCP-1 and a critical gene that governs the BAT/beige phenotype (PGC1α) were significantly decreased in the LTH lambs regardless of whether they were born at high altitude or at near sea level.

claims.text: Consider PPARγ upregulated in PRF of LTH lambs born at sea level, not high altitude.
claims.quote: PPARγ was significantly upregulated in PRF of LTH lambs born at sea level but not at high altitude.

claims.text: Consider DIO2 expression significantly lower in PRF of both LTH lamb groups.

conditions.value: high altitude and those born at sea level

claims.quote: DIO2 expression was significantly lower in the PRF of both LTH lambs born at high altitude and those born at sea level.

claims.text: Assess leptin expression elevated in lamb PRF only for LTH lambs born at sea level.
claims.quote: lamb PRF expression of leptin was elevated but only in the LTH lambs born at sea level.

claims.text: Consider RIP140 increased in LTH lambs born at high altitude, not sea level.
claims.quote: RIP140 was increased in the LTH lambs born at high altitude but not in those born at sea level.

claims.text: Consider loss of thyroid hormone signalling in PRF may drive post-birth loss of UCP-1 after LTH.
claims.quote: This indicates that the loss of thyroid hormone signalling in the PRF in response to LTH may play a significant role in the loss of UCP-1 in these lambs post-birth.

claims.text: Assess reduced UCP1 expression in perirenal fat of LTH lambs versus normoxic controls during fetal-to-neonatal transition.
claims.quote: in the transition from foetal to neonatal life when compared to normoxic controls, LTH lambs demonstrated a significant reduction in UCP1.

claims.text: Consider prior finding that LTH upregulated UCP1 and associated regulatory genes in the ovine fetus.
claims.quote: the expression of UCP1, a gene essential for non-shivering as well as associated regulatory genes were also upregulated by LTH.

claims.text: Consider prior finding that LTH augmented genes for endocrine regulation of adipocyte function and differentiation.

geneticContext.gene: genes critical to the endocrine regulation of adipocyte function and differentiation

claims.quote: development under conditions of LTH gave rise to the augmented expression of genes critical to the endocrine regulation of adipocyte function and differentiation.

claims.text: Assess subtle PRF gene-expression differences in LTH lambs born and maintained at high-altitude hypoxia.

conditions.value: mildly hypoxic high altitude mountain environment

claims.quote: there were subtle differences in gene expression in the PRF of LTH lambs born and maintained in a mildly hypoxic high altitude mountain environment

claims.text: Compare LTH lamb PRF expression to LTH lambs born in oxygen-replete near-sea-level conditions.

conditions.value: oxygen replete conditions at near sea level

claims.quote: compared to those born in oxygen replete conditions at near sea level.

claims.text: Note that pathways responsible for the LTH-induced shift in PRF gene expression remain undetermined.
claims.quote: the pathways responsible for this dramatic shift in PRF gene expression observed in response to LTH remained to be determined.

claims.text: Assess that SATB2 mRNA is markedly induced by hypoxia across tested LUAD cell lines.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR analysis showed that SATB2 mRNA expression was markedly induced by hypoxia across these LUAD cell lines ( Fig. 1A ).

claims.text: Consider increased SATB2 protein with HIF-1α stabilization in hypoxia-treated LUAD cells.

geneticContext.effect: increased SATB2 protein levels accompanied by HIF-1α stabilization

claims.quote: Consistently, western blot analysis revealed increased SATB2 protein levels accompanied by HIF-1α stabilization in hypoxia-treated LUAD cells ( Fig. 1B and Supplementary Fig. 1A).

claims.text: Note loss of HIF-1α markedly reduces SATB2 expression under normoxia and hypoxia.
claims.quote: Loss of HIF-1α led to a marked reduction in SATB2 expression under both normoxic and hypoxic conditions.

claims.text: Measure SATB2 mRNA by RT-qPCR after 24 h at 20% O2 versus 1% O2.

geneticContext.measurement: RT-qPCR analysis of SATB2 mRNA expression

claims.quote: (A) RT-qPCR analysis of SATB2 mRNA expression in indicated LUAD cell lines cultured under normoxia (20% O 2 ) or hypoxia (1% O 2 ) for 24 h.

claims.text: Measure HIF-1α and SATB2 protein by western blot after normoxia or hypoxia for 24 h.

geneticContext.measurement: Western blot analysis of HIF-1α and SATB2 protein expression

claims.quote: (B) Western blot analysis of HIF-1α and SATB2 protein expression in indicated LUAD cells exposed to normoxia or hypoxia for 24 h.

claims.text: Consider significantly increased SATB2 mRNA in LUAD tumors versus normal lung in TCGA-LUAD.
claims.quote: Analysis of the TCGA-LUAD cohort demonstrated significantly increased SATB2 mRNA expression in tumor tissues relative to normal lung tissues ( Fig. 2A ).

claims.text: Consider SATB2 promotes clonogenic growth, migratory capacity and angiogenic potential in LUAD cells.

geneticContext.effect: clonogenic growth, migratory capacity, and angiogenic potential

claims.quote: SATB2 promotes multiple malignant phenotypes of LUAD cells, including clonogenic growth, migratory capacity, and angiogenic potential

claims.text: Consider SATB2 enhances LUAD pro-angiogenic activity through regulation of tumor-derived soluble factors.
claims.quote: These observations indicate that SATB2 enhances the pro-angiogenic activity of LUAD cells through the regulation of tumor-derived soluble factors.

claims.text: Consider Western blotting to confirm SATB2 overexpression in A549, H1299 and Calu-3 cells.
claims.quote: SATB2 overexpression was confirmed by Western blotting in A549, H1299, and Calu-3 cells

claims.text: Consider SATB2 as induced by hypoxia and directly regulated by HIF-1α via promoter binding.
claims.quote: We found that SATB2 expression was induced by hypoxia and directly regulated by HIF-1α through promoter binding.

claims.text: Assess luciferase reporter and ChIP assays as support for SATB2 hypoxia-responsiveness in LUAD.
claims.quote: Luciferase reporter and ChIP assays supported SATB2 as a hypoxia-responsive chromatin regulator in LUAD.

claims.text: Consider HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3 and ALDOA as similarly enriched in malignant niches.
claims.quote: Consistently, multiple hypoxia-responsive genes, including HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3, and ALDOA, displayed similar enrichment patterns.

claims.text: Consider hypoxia as contributing to angiogenesis, metabolic adaptation, immune remodeling and therapeutic resistance.
claims.quote: Hypoxia represents a critical component of the LUAD tumor microenvironment and contributes to angiogenesis, metabolic adaptation, immune remodeling, and therapeutic resistance [ 22 ].

claims.text: Consider SATB2 cooperating with HIF-1α and p300 to enhance hypoxia-responsive transcription.
claims.quote: our findings indicate that SATB2 cooperates with HIF-1α and p300 to enhance hypoxia-responsive transcription.

claims.text: Interpret immune-related findings as correlative only given immunodeficient mouse models used.
claims.quote: The immunodeficient BALB/c nude mouse models used in this study cannot support functional conclusions regarding immune regulation

claims.text: Considere SATB2 como regulador epigenético inducible por hipoxia en LUAD.
claims.quote: we identify SATB2 as a previously unrecognized hypoxia-inducible epigenetic regulator in LUAD.

claims.text: Evalúe que HIF-1α activa el promotor de SATB2 y promueve su expresión en hipoxia.

geneticContext.perturbation: HIF-1α, unlike HIF-2α, directly interacts with the promoter of SATB2
geneticContext.effect: promoting its expression in hypoxic environments

claims.quote: HIF-1α, unlike HIF-2α, directly interacts with the promoter of SATB2, promoting its expression in hypoxic environments.

claims.text: Considere que perder SATB2 reduce H3K27ac y Pol II en elongación en loci diana HIF-1.

geneticContext.effect: reduces H3K27 acetylation and elongating RNA polymerase II occupancy

claims.quote: while SATB2 loss reduces H3K27 acetylation and elongating RNA polymerase II occupancy at HIF-1 target loci

claims.text: Considere modelos celulares LUAD, murinos y transcriptómica espacial con deconvolución para expresión.
claims.quote: by integrating LUAD cell models, murine tumor models, and spatial transcriptomics with reference-based cell-type deconvolution

claims.text: Evalúe programas hipóxicos asociados a SATB2 enriquecidos en nichos malignos y remodelación.
claims.quote: SATB2-associated hypoxic programs are preferentially enriched within malignant tumor niches and are associated with remodeling of the local tumor microenvironment.
